title: Recording with Edmund Hall and Walter Page for Decca
summary: Edmund Hall asks Leeman to record at Decca with Ralph Sutton and Walter Page, and Leeman later fails to recognize his own brushes on playback.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Hall, who was wonderful. He asked me to do a couple of recordings with him, and we went up to Decca and recorded -- "Big 'n' a" with him, we Ralph Sutton was on piano, and he took Walter Page up, and we made one or two recordings or albums -- I forget which; there was a transition then from 78's into LP's, and I never received those recordings. Somebody played them for me at a hall once, and I asked them who was playing brushes, who the drummer was -- I didn't even recognize my own playing. I felt very embarrassed admiring the drummer, and it turned out to be me.
